ALTER PROC [DW].[HIST_SP_DW_FACTTOTALRELATIONSHIPEXPOSURE] AS
BEGIN

WITH TRE AS (
SELECT [BusinessDateSK], DFLR.[BranchSK], DFLR.[BankSK], DFLR.[AccountSK], DFLR.[AccountID], [TotalRelationshipExposureFull], [TotalRelationshipExposureProrated] 
FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure DFLR
JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON DFLR.AccountSK = DDA.AccountSK AND DDA.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'LNS'
WHERE DDA.AccountStatus not in ('Closed')   


UNION ALL

SELECT [BusinessDateSK], DFCR.[BranchSK], DFCR.[BankSK], DFCR.[AccountSK], DFCR.[AccountID], [RelationshipExposure] as TotalRelationshipExposureFull, [RelationshipExposure]  as TotalRelationshipExposureProrated
FROM dw.FactCardsRelationshipExposure DFCR
JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON DFCR.AccountSK = DDA.AccountSK AND DDA.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'CCD'
WHERE DDA.AccountStatus not in ('8')

)

,Balance AS (
SELECT 
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,TRE.BusinessDateSK,112) AS BusinessDateSK
	,NULL [BranchSK]
	,TRE.[BankSK]
	,DCA.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
	,DCA.CustomerID AS CustomerID
	,SUM(ABS([TotalRelationshipExposureFull])) AS TotalRelationshipExposureFull
	,SUM(ABS([TotalRelationshipExposureProrated])) AS TotalRelationshipExposureProrated 
	,DC.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM TRE
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON TRE.AccountSK = DCA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer DC ON  DCA.CustomerSK = DC.CustomerSK
WHERE DC.CUSTOMERSK IS NOT NULL AND DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,TRE.BusinessDateSK,112) between '20210101' and '20211231'
GROUP BY 
 TRE.[BusinessDateSK]
,TRE.[BankSK]
,DCA.CustomerSK
,DCA.CustomerID
,DC.SourceSystemCode
)

,Distinct_Balance AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
    BranchSK, BankSK, CustomerSK, CustomerID, BusinessDateSK, TotalRelationshipExposureFull, TotalRelationshipExposureProrated, SourceSystemCode, WorkFlowId, TaskRunId, InsertDttm
FROM Balance )

INSERT INTO DW.FactTotalRelationshipExposure
SELECT
	BusinessDateSK
	,BranchSK
	,BankSK
	,CustomerSK
	,CustomerID
	,TotalRelationshipExposureFull
	,TotalRelationshipExposureProrated
	,SourceSystemCode
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
FROM Distinct_Balance B
where NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT * FROM DW.FactTotalRelationshipExposure A
  WHERE B.BusinessDateSK = A.BusinessDateSK
  AND B.CustomerID = A.CustomerID
  AND B.SourceSystemCode = A.SourceSystemCode
  AND B.[BankSK] = A.BankSK
)
	
END
GO
